definitions.explanation: Text added after the main body of a document or message. Also used as a suru verb meaning to add a supplementary note.

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}に{情報|じょうほう}を{追記|ついき}した。
examples.english: I added additional information to the article.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}いがあったので、ブログの{最後|さいご}に{追記|ついき}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: Since there was an error, I added a postscript at the end of the blog post.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {追|つい} (supplement, follow) + {記|き} (record, write). Used both as a noun and as a suru verb ({追記|ついき}する). Common in online writing, blogs, and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追記|ついき}する (to add a note)
- {追記|ついき}を{入|い}れる (to insert a postscript)
- {追記|ついき}{事項|じこう} (additional items)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {補足|ほそく}: supplement — adding clarification to make something more complete
- {付記|ふき}: appended note — a note attached to a document
